subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The lion caught the mouse and it began to tremble with fear. (b) The mouse remembered his promise and cut the net into pieces and let the lion come out. (c) While coming out of the net the lion said, 'It is a great lesson for me'. The lion also said, 'You are small in size but really worthly'. (d) 'Many thanks to you. You've saved my life', said the lion. (e) The mouse said, 'Let me go now, sooner or later, I may help you'. The lion laughed and said, 'O you! Are you suitable to help me?' (f) Once a lion was sleeping in a cave. (g) After some days the lion fell into a trap and was crying loudly for help. Listening to this, the mouse came swiftly and found the lion in a trap. (h) At that time, a mouse fell upon its body while playing. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (f) + (h) + (a) + (e) + (g) + (b) + (c) + (d) Section B : Writing Test
